shortDescription: CyberArk Platform Management using PAS Web Services SDK.

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: The base URL for PVWA REST APIs.

options.name: cyberark_session
options.description: Dictionary set by a CyberArk authentication containing the different values to perform actions on a logged-on CyberArk session, please see M(cyberark.isp.cyberark_authentication) module for an example of cyberark_session.

options.name: duplicate_from_platform
options.description: The unique ID/Name of the platform to duplicate from.

options.name: logging_file
options.description: Setting the log file name and location for troubleshooting logs.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output to the C(logging_file) value.

options.name: platform_id
options.description: The unique ID/Name of the platform.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the state needed for the user present for create user, absent for delete user.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the server to send data before giving up

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificate chain will not be validated.  This should only set to C(true) if you have a root CA certificate installed on each node.
